name: teamlift-office-hours
description: Publish 1:1 office-hour slots and let clients book them.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @teamlift/api" "npm run dev -w @teamlift/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @teamlift/api && npm run build -w @teamlift/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @teamlift/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @teamlift/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @teamlift/api && npm run typecheck -w @teamlift/web
